title: Merge Sort
markdown:
Divide into halves, recursively sort, then merge the sorted halves.

![Merge Sort: Divide into halves, recursively sort, then merge](study/assets/asset-merge-sort-%E5%BD%92%E5%B9%B6%E6%8E%92%E5%BA%8F%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95%E5%9B%BE%E8%A7%A3.png)

- **Base case**: stop when subarray size $\le 1$.
- **Split point**: `mid` is an index / split position ($lo + (hi - lo) / 2$), never the element value stored at $S[n/2]$.
- **Merge contract**: takes two already-sorted subarrays and produces one combined sorted array.
